Seagull flew high over the sea.
She looked down at the little boats, the sandy beach and the sunny harbour.
Then she saw a big pirate hat she knew.
Captain Kathryn was running to her ship, waving a piece of paper.
She looked very happy!
Seagull swooped down, down, down, and she landed right on top of Kathryn's big hat.
Squawk! Squawk! Squawk! What's up, Kathryn?
said Seagull.
Kathryn held up an old map with a little island on it and a big red X.
I've found the map to the lost treasure!
said Kathryn.
X marks the treasure!
Kathryn ran up onto her ship.
Ahoy, pirates! Hoist the sail! We're going to find the lost treasure!
Her crew came running.
Izzy looked after the map and the compass.
Pancake Polly made the yummiest pancakes.
Billy could climb all the way up the mast.
Seagull flapped her wings.
A treasure hunt? I love treasure hunts! I'm coming too!
Hooray! Then sit on my hat until we find the treasure,
Izzy, Pancake Polly and Billy danced a happy pirate dance across the deck.
Yo ho, yo ho!
sang Izzy.
sang Billy.
We're going to find the lost treasure!
sang Pancake Polly.
Billy pulled the rope, and up went the big sail.
Flap, flap, flap!
Kathryn turned the ship's big wheel.
Off we go to Treasure Island!
And away they sailed, far across the sea.
The trip was long, long, long.
Soon everyone on deck felt slow and grumbly, and nobody knew why.
Billy, can you see an island?
Billy sat in the basket at the top of the mast, but he was too hungry to answer.
He just gave a big yawn.
His tummy went rumble, rumble, rumble!
Izzy, can you check the map with your compass?
Izzy sat on a barrel with the map on her lap, but she was hungry too, and she didn't answer.
She just gave a big sigh.
Her tummy went rumble, rumble, rumble!
Let me go and see what's wrong!
said Seagull, and she flew all around the ship.
Every tummy went rumble, rumble, rumble!
Even Kathryn's tummy!
Squawk! Squawk! Squawk! I know! Everyone is hungry!
Seagull flew down the steps to the ship's kitchen.
There was Pancake Polly, stirring pancake mix in her big blue bowl.
Polly, Polly! Everyone is too hungry to find the treasure!
Hungry pirates? Then it's pancake time!
said Pancake Polly.
Up came Pancake Polly with a big pile of plates.
There were pancakes with banana, strawberries and honey for everyone!
The pirates ate and ate, and Seagull had a pancake too.
Yum, yum, yum!
Now everyone was full of pancakes and full of energy!
Izzy and Pancake Polly danced across the deck, and Billy sang from the top of the mast.
I spot an island!
said Billy, and he pointed far across the sea.
Everyone cheered.
Kathryn looked through her telescope.
There it is! Treasure Island!
The ship stopped near the island, and Seagull flew ahead to the sandy beach.
There in the sand lay two long sticks in a big X.
Squawk! Squawk! Squawk! I found it! X marks the treasure!
Splish, splash, splosh!
Behind her, the pirates waded to the beach with their spades.
Dig, dig, dig!
The pirates dug at the X.
Up came an old wooden treasure chest.
Kathryn lifted the lid.
Inside were gold coins, sparkly jewels and shiny pearls, enough for everyone!
We found the lost treasure!
That evening, as the sun went down, the pirates had a treasure party on the beach, with music and dancing.
Kathryn gave Seagull a big hug.
Thank you, Seagull. You're the best friend a pirate could have!
Squawk, squawk, squawk,
said Seagull softly, and she snuggled down on Kathryn's big hat.
